captions_note: the LED screen covers the whole frame and carries the words, so build.py writes work/reel_captions.json and the reel's captions step aside from the cut until the speaker has settled back
in_a_reel: the words are the speaker's own, each on the frame it is said (WORDS = None takes them from the slot's words.json)
T_IN 2 or later and T_OUT 2 frames or more before the slot ends: the slot starts and ends on the plain picture
best on a short punchy line of 3 to 6 words; a long sentence turns into a slideshow
steps: edit the CLIP block in build.py: T_IN, T_OUT, ACCENT (WORDS = None reads them from words.json)
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the words with their frames and the snapshot times
